title: Administrator
description:
Temporary Planning Administrator (Shifts) - Huddersfield (Immediate Start) - Temp to Perm Opportunity

Are you highly organised with exceptional administrative skills? Our key client in Huddersfield is seeking a Temporary Planning Administrator to join their busy team immediately - this role will go permanent to the right candidate.

Shift Pattern (12-week rotating schedule):
- Early: 06:00 - 15:00
- Late: 09:00 - 18:00
- Mid: 07:00 - 16:00 (flexible start between 07:00-08:30, finish 16:00-17:30)

You'll play a vital role in supporting the Planning Manager and ensuring smooth coordination of deliveries. This position focuses on administrative excellence-managing data, optimising resources using a computerised planning system, and maintaining accurate records. You'll help deliver safe, cost-effective solutions while providing outstanding customer service.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, can work independently, and have strong organisational skills, this is the perfect opportunity. You'll need experience in a similar role, excellent IT skills (especially Excel and Outlook), and the ability to interpret data accurately.

Key Skills Required
- Planning Experience
- Attention to Detail - accuracy in data interpretation and record-keeping
- IT Proficiency - strong skills in Microsoft Office (Excel & Outlook)
- Organisational Ability - prioritising tasks and meeting deadlines
- Communication Skills - confident, assertive, and able to build relationships
- Adaptability - working unsupervised and reacting to issues quickly
- Knowledge of UK Geography
- Team Player - collaborative approach in a busy environment

Benefits
- Competitive hourly salary
- Supportive team environment
- On-site car parking
- Training will be provided, and there is potential to progress into a role with more responsibilities and an uplift in pay.

title: Contract Data Administrator
description:
Data Contract Administrator - 6 Month Temp Project

£27,600 per annum equivalent (£14.36 per hour) Hybrid Huddersfield (HD6 area)

We're currently recruiting for a Data Contract Administrator to join a growing business based in the Huddersfield area, supporting their team with a mixture of contract administration, data management and high-volume data input.

This is a particularly exciting time to join the business, as they are currently going through a period of growth and are expecting another significant push before the end of the year. As a result, there is a real possibility that this role could extend beyond the initial 6-month contract as the business continues to grow.

We're open to candidates from a range of backgrounds, but this could be a particularly good opportunity for a recent graduate or someone with some previous office/admin experience who is confident working with data, comfortable using Excel and keen to develop their career within a growing business.

The role is largely remote working, with only around 1-2 days per month required in the office, making this an excellent opportunity for someone looking for a genuinely flexible hybrid position - Ideally the company would like someone in a commutable distance within the surrounding area though in case this were to change in the future or the travel element were to develop.

What will you be doing?

As a Data Contract Administrator, you'll play an important role in ensuring contract information is accurately entered, maintained and up to date across the company's systems.

You'll be responsible for:
- Accurately inputting, updating and verifying contract data across company databases and systems
- Managing high volumes of data while maintaining a consistently high level of accuracy
- Carrying out checks to ensure data is complete, accurate and meets company standards
- Identifying and correcting any errors or discrepancies within the data
- Working closely with the Sales and Operations Teams to resolve any inaccuracies or queries
- Supporting the wider team with effective data management and administration
- Ensuring contract information is maintained correctly and efficiently
- Working independently to manage your workload and meet agreed deadlines

What are we looking for?

We're open to candidates from a range of backgrounds for this position. Previous experience in data entry or administration would be beneficial, but we're particularly interested in finding someone who has the right approach and is confident working with data.

We're looking for:
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
- Good Excel skills and confidence working with large volumes of data
- The ability to work independently, manage your own workload and meet deadlines
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- The ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across different teams
- A willingness and ability to learn new systems and processes
- Previous experience in data entry or a similar administrative role would be beneficial
- Experience using CRM, ERP, SAP, Protean or other database management systems would be desirable

This could be a particularly good opportunity for a recent graduate with strong Excel skills who is looking to begin their career in an administrative/data-focused role, or someone with some previous office experience who is looking for their next step.

What's in it for you?

This is a great opportunity to join a business at an exciting stage of its growth and gain valuable experience across data management, contract administration, Excel and business systems.

With further growth expected before the end of the year, there is also a strong possibility of the position continuing beyond the initial 6-month contract, depending on the needs and growth of the business.

The details

Location: Huddersfield, HD6
Working pattern: Predominantly remote, with 1-2 days in the office per month
Hours: Full-time, either 8am-4pm or 9am-5pm
Contract: Initial 6-month temporary contract, then to be reviewed
Salary: £27,600 per annum equivalent / £14.36 per hour for the temporary assignment
Pay: Weekly for the temporary assignment
Start: ASAP

If you're a graduate, have some administration experience, or simply have a real eye for detail and enjoy working with data, this could be a fantastic opportunity to get your foot in the door with a growing business.

Looking for your next opportunity? Think Specialist Recruitment.

Think Specialist Recruitment is an independent support staff recruitment agency based in Hemel Hempstead, working across the Herts, Beds and Bucks area. We specialise in permanent and temporary recruitment across administration, customer service, PA/secretarial, HR, accountancy & finance, sales support, marketing and IT.

title: Customer Service Administrator
description:
Customer Service & Logistics Admin

Huddersfield

Circa £25,500 per annum

Our client, a market-leading business within the Huddersfield area, is looking to recruit a proactive and organised Customer Services and Logistics Administrator to join their existing established team. This role is responsible for delivering excellent customer service while coordinating the efficient movement of goods and ensuring smooth day-to-day operational processes. The successful candidate will act as the key link between customers, suppliers, warehouse operations, and internal departments to ensure orders are processed accurately and delivered on time.

In addition to customer service and logistics responsibilities, the role includes a range of administrative and operational support duties that contribute to the overall success of the business.

Key Customer Service Responsibilities
- Act as the primary point of contact for customer enquiries via telephone, email, and online channels.
- Deliver a professional, friendly, and responsive customer experience, building strong relationships with customers.
- Process customer orders accurately and efficiently, ensuring all information is entered correctly.
- Provide customers with timely updates on orders, product availability, lead times, and deliveries.
- Resolve customer queries, complaints, and issues promptly, escalating where appropriate.
- Liaise with internal departments to ensure customer requirements are met and expectations are managed.
- Process returns, credits, and replacement orders in line with company procedures.
- Identify opportunities to improve customer experience and contribute to service improvements.
- Support the sales team by providing administrative assistance where required.

Key Logistics Support Responsibilities
- Support the coordination of customer deliveries by liaising with suppliers, warehouse staff, and transport providers.
- Monitor delivery schedules and communicate any delays or changes to customers and internal teams.
- Assist with arranging collections, dispatches, and return shipments.
- Prepare delivery documentation and maintain accurate logistics records.
- Work closely with the operations team to help ensure orders are fulfilled accurately and on time.
- Assist in resolving delivery-related queries and escalating issues where necessary.
- Provide administrative support for logistics processes and help maintain efficient workflows.

Key Admin & Operational Support Responsibilities
- Act as a key point of contact for a variety of operational tasks outside the standard remit of the role.
- Maintain accurate records, filing systems, and operational documentation.
- Produce routine reports relating to customer service and order management.
- Support purchase order processing and supplier communications where required.
- Assist with invoicing, credit notes, returns, and general administrative tasks.
- Contribute to the review and improvement of customer service and operational processes.
- Provide support to colleagues across customer service, sales, and operations during busy periods.
- Undertake any other duties reasonably requested by management.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Essential
- Previous experience in customer service, logistics, supply chain, or operations coordination.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong organisational and time management abilities.
- High level of attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Experience with Sage is required.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word.
- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

Personal Attributes
- Customer-focused with a positive and professional attitude.
- Reliable, flexible, and adaptable.
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Strong attention to detail.
- Calm under pressure with excellent organisational skills.
- A proactive approach to identifying and solving problems.
- Committed to delivering high standards of service and operational excellence.

If you would like any further details on the above role, please forward your CV for consideration.

Mpeople, are a recruitment business acting on behalf of our clients. If you do not receive a response within 5 days, please presume you have been unsuccessful on this occasion.

INDYO

title: Personal Assistant
description:
Personal Assistant to Sales Director

Role Overview

Are you highly organised, proactive and confident working closely with senior management?

We are looking for a Personal Assistant to support our Sales Director and wider commercial team, providing high-quality administrative, organisational and sales support within one of the fastest-growing specialised Truck Rental companies in the country.

This is more than a traditional administration role. You will become a key support to the Sales Director, helping manage their diary, meetings, customer information and day-to-day workload. A key part of the role will involve attending sales meetings, taking accurate notes, recording actions and ensuring all relevant information is inputted onto our CRM and internal systems.

You will need to be organised, commercially aware and confident dealing with customers and colleagues at all levels. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with PA, Executive Assistant, Sales Support or Senior Administration experience who wants to develop within a fast-paced and growing business.

Key Responsibilities

Provide day-to-day PA and administrative support to the Sales Director.

Manage diaries, appointments, meetings and customer visits.

Attend sales meetings and take clear, accurate notes of discussions, decisions and agreed actions.

Input meeting notes, customer updates, actions and sales information accurately onto the CRM and internal systems.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records, contacts and sales information.

Monitor actions following meetings and ensure key tasks are followed up and completed.

Prepare meeting agendas, reports, presentations and other sales documentation.

Support the Sales Director with quotations, contracts, correspondence and customer documentation.

Handle telephone calls and emails, dealing with queries professionally or directing them to the appropriate person.

Coordinate with workshop, logistics, finance and other internal departments on behalf of the Sales Director.

Assist with customer visits, sales events and promotional activity in conjunction with the wider team.

Arrange travel, accommodation and other requirements for business meetings and visits.

Help monitor sales opportunities and ensure relevant information is recorded accurately within company systems.

Maintain confidentiality when dealing with commercially sensitive and customer information.

Keep up to date with company products and services to provide accurate information to customers and colleagues.

Provide general administrative and organisational support to help the Sales Director and sales team operate effectively.

Required Skills & Experience

Essential

Proven experience in a PA, Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant, Sales Support or senior administration role.

Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Excellent note-taking skills and a high level of accuracy when recording and inputting information.

Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Word and Excel.

Comfortable using CRM, databases and other computerised systems.

Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.

Professional and confident when communicating with customers, colleagues and senior management.

Ability to work independently, use initiative and anticipate the needs of the Sales Director.

Friendly, professional and commercially aware approach.

Good GCSEs or equivalent in Maths and English.

Desirable

Previous experience supporting a Sales Director, Managing Director or senior manager.

Experience within sales, commercial administration or customer service.

Experience within the HGV, truck rental, transport or automotive sector.

Previous experience using CRM systems.

Experience preparing sales reports, presentations or meeting documentation.

Understanding of sales processes and commercial operations.

Benefits

23 days paid annual leave + bank holidays

Company workplace pension scheme (auto-enrolment)

Free on-site parking

Training and career progression opportunities

Death in service (after qualifying period)

title: Medical receptionist
description: We are recruiting for a medical receptionist to join our friendly and busy team. This role provides reception and administrative support to the whole practice. Customer service experience and IT skills are essential. A knowledge of primary care and the IT system (System One) would be an advantage but not essential as training is provided. Good written and oral communication skills are also essential as well as good time management and organisational skills to prioritise your workload, along with an understand of, and commitment to, patient confidentiality. Welcoming patients to the surgery and providing a friendly and professional reception service.Answering incoming telephone calls promptly and dealing with a wide range of patient queries. Booking, cancelling and rearranging GP, nurse and other clinical appointments. Supporting patients with general enquiries and directing them to the appropriate service. Take accurate messages and relaying information to the relevant team members. Managing the reception area and assisting patients with check-in and other administrative queries. Liaising with GPs, nurses, administrative staff and other healthcare professionals. Maintaining accurate and confidential patient records. Handling sensitive and sometimes challenging conversations calmly, respectfully and professionally. Following practice procedures relating to confidentiality, safeguarding, information governance and patient care. Carrying out general administrative duties to support the smooth running of the practice. Please see receptionist job description attached to this advert in supporting documents. Full training will be provided.

title: Receptionist/ Telephonist
description: Elmwood Family Doctors is a large, forward-thinking GP practice serving our local community across two sites in Holmfirth and Meltham . We are looking to recruit an enthusiastic, friendly and motivated Receptionist/Telephonist to join our supportive and dedicated team. Hours of Work (19 hours per week) Monday: 8:00am to 6:00pm Tuesday: 8:00am to 1:00pm Wednesday: 3:00pm to 8:00pm As the first point of contact for our patients, you will play an important role in delivering excellent customer service and helping ensure patients receive the support and care they need. Strong communication skills, a positive attitude and the ability to work effectively as part of a team are essential. At Elmwood Family Doctors, we pride ourselves on being a friendly, welcoming and supportive practice where staff are valued and encouraged to develop. Holmfirth and Meltham are fantastic places to live and work, offering excellent schools, a strong sense of community and a vibrant programme of local events and festivals. Surrounded by the beautiful Pennine countryside, the area also benefits from excellent amenities and convenient transport links to Leeds, Manchester and Sheffield. If you enjoy working with people, thrive in a busy environment and want to make a real difference to healthcare within your local community, we would love to hear from you. The role involves supporting patients with their enquiries, booking appointments, and signposting them to the most appropriate services. This is predominantly carried out over the telephone, alongside providing a welcoming and professional face-to-face service at the reception desk. Successful candidates will spend part of each shift working within our dedicated telephone team, supported by friendly colleagues and ongoing training. Strong customer service skills and the ability to work effectively as part of a team are essential. The role also includes a variety of administrative tasks. While full training will be provided, good IT skills are essential, and previous administrative experience would be advantageous. We are looking for someone who is approachable, organised and motivated, with excellent communication skills and a positive team-focused attitude. Experience in a similar role within the NHS or healthcare setting would be beneficial, but is not essential. The role involves supporting the delivery of a high-quality GP service by acting as a first point of contact for patients and visitors. You will provide a friendly, efficient and accurate service, assisting with appointment booking, patient enquiries and a range of administrative duties. Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to): Welcoming patients and handling enquiries at the reception desk Responding to telephone enquiries and directing patients to the most appropriate service Booking and managing patient appointments Using clinical IT systems (including SystmOne) to carry out administrative tasks such as patient registrations, updating records, and scanning correspondence into digital records Processing, repeat prescriptions and clinical information Supporting clinical staff, including chaperoning patients where appropriate Maintaining clinical areas, including re-stocking rooms Hours and Location This is a part-time role worked over a 3-day shift pattern, with shifts scheduled across the week to meet the needs of the service. The role is based across both of our sites in Holmfirth and Meltham , and staff are required to work flexibly between the two locations. This provides the opportunity to work closely with a wide range of colleagues and patients, and to develop a varied and rewarding role. Due to the nature of the role and the importance of teamwork and patient interaction, this position is fully on-site. The successful candidate may need to be able to travel between both sites.
